about: Reviewed identity decisions for src/data/sites.json. Applied by dedupe_sites.py apply; see hb_pipeline/site_merge.py for what each action does.

decisions.reason: The UNESCO property Samarra Archaeological City is the Abbasid capital's ruin-field itself, so the two cards described one site.
The mosque and shrine stand on the Nebi Yunus mound (Tell al-Tawba); the mound keeps its own card for the Assyrian palace beneath.
The stele was set up at Topzawa near Sidakan, the settlement site; its present custody (in place or in Erbil) is disputed.
A church in the modern town and the ancient mounds; they share only the town's name Karemlash.
Two shrines of Pir Mehmed Reshan, near Bardarash and on Mount Sinjar, about 150 km apart.
Churches of the same saint in two towns.
Separate entries in the Erbil archaeological site list.
Numbered sites of the same survey.
Survey sites TJ 11 and TJ 12 of the Kokushikan Tanjarow survey.
Different islands of the Haditha reservoir survey.
Different excavated Hamrin tells; only their proposed ancient names (Awal, Awalki) look alike.
Separate numbered entries on Yaseen's Hamrin map.
Sites 61 and 68 on Yaseen's Hamrin map.
Sites 45 and 56 on Yaseen's Hamrin map.
